sc25.notes: Company outline with its label, then three identical lit store fronts, in the order the storyboard gives (start frame and 2.6s). On 'stopped' the middle store's windows go dark and the amber 'closing' tag drops onto its awning (mid frame). On 'carries' the outline and label pulse once in slate while the outer stores stay lit (14.4s). By 14.9s they are back to muted grey, so the outline no longer stays slate for the rest of the scene. The pulse ends before the fade-out (end frame). Both onScreenText lines are legible. There are no names, logos or figures, and both BLS citations are on screen throughout. Not blocking, and in a shared component: the citation subline repeats the file name ('bls-qcew-concepts.txt (bls-qcew-concepts.txt, lines 48-48)').
